interview.hardest_part: Navigating the hotel interior from single screenshots with arrow-key turning and half-second steps. The route has several hard spots: smoke-filled and burning corridors, many similar-looking doors and rooms, a stairwell down to the elevator, then the elevator wait and the ground-floor path to the safe room. On top of that, the special-infected milestones (8, 12 and 16 kills) and the revive and heal-count milestones need specific situations that may never come up in one chapter.
interview.likely_failure: Getting disoriented or stuck: turning in circles in hallways, losing track of the bots, walking into fire, or failing to find the stairwell or elevator. That would stall route progress somewhere between about 30% and 60%. A second risk is being pinned by a Hunter or Smoker or incapacitated in fire while the bots are far away. I also expect to undercount special kills, because the bots usually kill specials before I can aim at them.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Easy difficulty means low infected health and low damage taken. The AI teammates lead the route, revive and heal me, and kill threats, so following them gives navigation cues. Survivor silhouettes, item and route outlines help orientation. Holding J gives automatic fire, so the shot milestones (25, 100, 300) and many common kills come easily during hordes. Medkits and pills near the start make the heal milestones possible by pressing 4 and holding J. Once I pass 9% of the route, the survival timers accumulate passively, and slow play actually helps reach the 10, 15 and 20 minute marks.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Every action is a half-second step chosen from a static screenshot, so aiming at fast-moving infected is coarse and turning by arrow keys is imprecise. Fire and smoke damage and block visibility. Special infected (Hunter, Smoker, Jockey, Charger) can disable me between frames. The hotel's maze-like layout and similar corridors cause disorientation. The run allows only 1 attempt, so death or a softlock loses the remaining route points. Revives need a downed teammate, which is rare on Easy, and specials are scarce and shared with the bots, which caps the higher kill tiers. The 3-hour wall-clock budget includes thinking time, which limits how many actions I can take.
